verdict.rationale: Terraform documents a provider ecosystem for managing infrastructure on 'any cloud', covering both cloud and on-prem resources. A public Registry lets anyone publish and consume providers, and you can write your own. Community users corroborate real-world multi-account cloud use and third-party providers such as Kubernetes. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of named coverage for the major clouds beyond AWS (Azure, GCP), evidence of SaaS-provider breadth, and any provider count or ecosystem-scale figures.
